symptoms: API calls fail with E401 for an installation still using legacy authentication.
customer_context: Legacy authentication configuration; no real customer identifiers.

attempted_solutions.solution: Use exponential backoff and inspect endpoint throttling

symptoms: Downstream handler processes the same event more than once after a timeout.

attempted_solutions.solution: Deduplicate on event ID with an idempotency store

symptoms: Rows appear under incorrect fields after import.

attempted_solutions.solution: Normalize and validate header row against the import mapping

symptoms: Integrations begin returning 401 after a period of inactivity.

attempted_solutions.solution: Refresh token before expiry and handle revoked refresh tokens

symptoms: Large report requests exceed the client timeout under load.

attempted_solutions.solution: Use bounded exponential backoff and request pagination

symptoms: Legacy authentication mapping stops working after upgrade.

attempted_solutions.solution: Configure OAuth credentials using the v5 migration checklist
